name: compiled-audio-policy
goal: The compiled renderer plays a recorded clip from its checked blob: the policy allows blob media and keeps script, frame, object and connect limits.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Compiled renderer blocked a recorded blob clip: rendererPolicy had no media-src. Dev server has no policy, so only the HARNESS_VERIFY run shows it.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Fresh export, built: HARNESS_VERIFY=1 playwright ui-evidence-behavior, unchanged spec 808b1458: 1 failed (duration NaN), 4 passed. Policy guard: 2 failed, 2 passed. /tmp/harness-audio-red.keep.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: rendererPolicy gains media-src 'self' blob: and nothing else. README and both script headers start fixture and acceptance through their normal scripts.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Export rebuilt from clean: same specs under HARNESS_VERIFY=1, 23 passed; ui-designs 6 passed; unchanged guard 4 passed; main.cjs carries the directive. /tmp/harness-audio-green.log

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
